Each quadrant contains one complete isolated tower with ample clear gap; no object or glow crosses a quadrant. Square canvas at the largest supported resolution. Strong broad shapes survive a 70×96-pixel game display. No photorealism or microscopic decorative noise. Soft lighting from upper left; dark useful outline at the silhouette. Every tower stands on its own compact low stone plinth, centered upright, same camera and same baseline within its cell. Towers have about 3:4 overall width-to-height silhouette, not long horizontal platforms.

Grid reading order:
TOP LEFT = star 7 TWIN CRYSTAL SPIRE: TWO clearly separated tall faceted blue crystal spires like unequal twin prongs, joined low by a compact ivory armored keep. An unmistakable V notch between them; no crown or observatory dome.
TOP RIGHT = star 8 PRISM BATTERY: a BROAD STURDY angular artillery housing, three large faceted prism panels forming a forward-facing crystal cannon; stepped low side buttresses and one huge blue central hexagonal emitter. Shorter and wider visual mass than the twin spire, but upright overall.
BOTTOM LEFT = star 9 CELESTIAL OBSERVATORY: ONE tall slender octagonal observation tower with a large blue domed roof and tilted brass astronomical ring, a short visible telescope pointing forward. Strong round dome silhouette, no twin prongs.
BOTTOM RIGHT = star 10 STAR-CROWN ASTRONOMICAL CASTLE: regal upright castle with FIVE large crown points forming a single open star crown around a luminous blue orb, broad ivory central keep and two lower stepped side towers. Readable crown silhouette, larger and more imposing than others.

All four: place the MAIN WEAPON EMITTER / luminous focus precisely on the horizontal centerline about TWO THIRDS of the total tower height above the foot of the plinth (one third down from top). It must be visually explicit and open toward the viewer, because game projectiles originate there. Keep tallest decorative tips above it. A single small ivory D6 square plaque below this emitter has EXACTLY FIVE dark/navy circular pips in the standard four corners plus center arrangement. The plaque is a flat visible square face, no extra side faces and no extra pips or rune dots nearby. D6 convention is essential, star tier is NOT pip count. Different architecture is the primary identity. Keep all four designs unique, polished, complete and ready for alpha sprite extraction.

Each tower stands on a very low compact stone plinth with same local cell foot baseline.

TOP LEFT: TWIN CRYSTAL SPIRE. Two short substantial parallel crystal prongs above a high central blue orb at upper-quarter height, deep V notch between them, a long slim ivory/navy twin-column fortified support below. Unique fork silhouette. Keep both prongs' tops close enough to orb height to satisfy the upper-quarter emitter location.
TOP RIGHT: PRISM BATTERY. A massive faceted hexagonal blue cannon head at the upper quarter, framed by three short backward prism fins on a tall sturdy narrow angular stepped artillery pedestal; silhouette a faceted block hammer at top with a long armored vertical support. Not a wide squat castle, not a spike bundle.
BOTTOM LEFT: CELESTIAL OBSERVATORY. A round navy-blue observatory dome and thin tilted brass orbital ring forming a short round head at top. The forward telescope terminates in a bright central blue lens at upper-quarter height; long slender octagonal ivory observation tower below. No additional lower glowing core. Round head silhouette.
BOTTOM RIGHT: STAR-CROWN ASTRONOMICAL CASTLE. A compact five-point open golden-and-blue crown around a high luminous blue orb at upper-quarter height; long regal narrow ivory central keep with two lower stepped buttresses. Crown silhouette, no additional lower glowing core. Distinct from the fork/dome/hexagonal cannon.
